[00:04] Welcome to today's tech briefing. Today we highlight three compelling stories: Texas kicks off critical federal test flights for electric air taxis; nearly three thousand illuminated drones recreate the Twin Towers over New York Harbor; and Oxford astrophysicists challenge the existence of dark energy, suggesting cosmic acceleration may be an illusion.

[00:26] Electric Air Taxis Begin Crucial Test Flights in Texas. A major federal test program for electric and autonomous aircraft has officially launched in Texas today. Under a new White House pilot initiative, leading air taxi makers including Joby, Beta, and Wisk are demonstrating regional flight paths. Over the next week, these aircraft will fly routes connecting urban centers and regional airports, including Dallas Fort Worth International Airport. Regulators want to evaluate the technical feasibility (可行性；切实可行) (可行性；可实施性。) of low-altitude passenger flights in busy metropolitan areas. The test flights will not carry passengers, but they allow air traffic controllers to observe how existing systems accommodate (容纳；适应并接纳。) electric aircraft. For manufacturers, collecting this flight data is a crucial step toward winning official type certification (认证；核准资质。) from aviation authorities. While urban air mobility promises to reduce traffic gridlock (交通瘫痪；僵局。), companies must still overcome substantial (重大的；实质性的。) challenges like battery weight limits and legal battles over proprietary technology.
德州开启电动空中出租车试飞，探索低空载人交通新航线。一项针对电动与自主飞行器的重要联邦测试项目今天在德克萨斯州正式启动。在白宫新试点倡议的支持下，包括 Joby、Beta 和 Wisk 在内的领先空中出租车制造商正在验证区域飞行航线。在接下来的一周里，这些飞行器将执飞连接城市中心与区域机场（包括达拉斯-沃斯堡国际机场）的航线。监管机构希望评估低空客运飞行在繁忙都市圈运行的技术可行性。虽然测试飞行不会搭载任何乘客，但它们能让空中交通管制员观察现有系统如何接纳电动飞行器。对于制造企业而言，收集这些飞行数据是获得民航局官方适航认证的关键一步。尽管城市空中交通有望缓解地面交通拥堵，但相关企业仍须克服诸如电池重量限制以及围绕专有技术展开的法律纷争等严峻挑战。（来源：The Verge Tech & Culture）

[01:27] Fleet of 2,977 Drones Recreates Twin Towers over New York City. A spectacular memorial display featuring nearly three thousand synchronized (同步的；协调一致的。) drones took flight over New York Harbor this week. Exactly two thousand nine hundred and seventy-seven drones formed a life-sized illuminated (被照亮的；发光的。) outline of the original Twin Towers. Each light directly honored an individual victim of the September 11 terrorist attacks. The installation, titled '2,977 Lights Over New York Harbor,' was organized in close partnership with survivors, victims' families, and emergency first responders. Crowds watched in solemn (庄严的；肃穆的。) silence as the luminous (发光的；明亮的。) structures hovered gracefully against the night sky. The project demonstrates how modern drone swarm technology can serve as a touching medium for public art and collective remembrance. By merging precise aviation engineering with deep communal reverence (崇敬；敬意。), the tribute offered a powerful symbol of enduring peace and unity.
2977架无人机在纽约港上空点亮夜空，全比例重现双子塔悼念911遇难者。一场由近三千架同步无人机呈现的壮丽纪念表演本周在纽约港上空点亮。整整 2,977 架无人机在夜空中勾勒出原世界贸易中心双子塔等比例的发光轮廓。每一盏光束都直接致敬在“9·11”恐怖袭击中遇难的一位逝者。这项名为“纽约港上空的 2,977 盏光芒”的装置艺术，是由幸存者、遇难者家属及紧急救援人员紧密合作组织的。大批民众在肃穆与寂静中驻足瞻仰，看着发光的塔身结构在夜空中优雅悬停。该项目展示了现代无人机集群控制技术如何成为公共艺术与集体追思的动人载体。通过将精密的航空工程与深沉的公众敬意相融合，这场纪念仪式传递了持久和平与团结的强大象征。（来源：Hacker News）

[02:25] Oxford Physicists Challenge Dark Energy and Cosmic Acceleration. A team of astrophysicists led by Oxford professor Subir Sarkar has published research challenging the widely accepted existence of dark energy. For decades, the standard cosmological consensus (共识；一致意见。) held that the expansion of the universe is accelerating. However, Sarkar suggests that this cosmic acceleration might simply be an observational (观测的；根据观察得出的。) illusion. The researchers argue that our solar system and galaxy cluster move rapidly across space, which generates a noticeable dipole effect in astronomical observations. When scientists account for this peculiar (特殊的；特有的（天文上指本动）。) motion, the statistical evidence for acceleration weakens considerably. If confirmed, this finding could radically (彻底地；根本上地。) reshape modern physics and prompt scientists to rethink fundamental theories about cosmic evolution. While many mainstream cosmologists remain cautious, the study underscores how fresh analytical perspectives can challenge long-standing scientific dogmas (信条；定论；教条。).
牛津学者质疑暗能量假说，指出宇宙加速膨胀或为运动视错觉。由牛津大学教授苏比尔·萨卡尔领导的天体物理学家团队发表了一项新研究，对科学界普遍接受的暗能量理论提出了挑战。数十年来，主流宇宙学共识一直认为宇宙的膨胀正在不断加速。然而，萨卡尔指出，这种宇宙加速膨胀可能仅仅是一种观测上的视错觉。研究团队认为，我们的太阳系和星系群在太空中高速运动，这在天文观测中产生了一种显著的偶极效应。当科学家在数据中校正这种局域运动后，支持宇宙加速膨胀的统计证据就大幅减弱了。如果这一结论得到证实，它将彻底重塑现代物理学，并促使科学家重新审视关于宇宙演化的基础理论。尽管许多主流宇宙学家仍持谨慎态度，但这项研究凸显了全新的分析视角如何能够对长期存在的科学定论发起有力挑战。（来源：Slashdot）
